items.title: State Senate: Republicans keep a bare majority
items.text: Republicans lead or are unopposed in 29 of 56 seats, the minimum for a majority. Their closest lead is 1,661 votes, 2.0 points, in SD-32.

items.title: State House: Democrats gain a majority
items.text: Democrats lead or are unopposed in 92 of 180 seats, 1 more than the 91 needed for a majority. Their closest lead is 35 votes, 0.1 points, in HD-103.

items.title: U.S. Senate: Jon Ossoff wins by 18.1 points
items.text: Jon Ossoff leads Mike Collins by 755,386 votes, 18.1 points. The margin is 9.6 points higher than the 2024 Democratic margin against Kamala Harris.

items.title: Runoff for HD-151 set for Dec 1
items.text: Mike Cheokas (R) leads Ethan Wolfe (D) by 1,381 votes, 7.0 points. The top two will face off in a runoff on Dec 1.

items.title: Constitutional Amendments pass with strong margins
items.text: Yes votes for Amendments 1, 2, and 3 exceed No votes by 7.7, 36.7, and 55.5 points respectively. All amendments will take effect on Jan 1, 2027.

items.title: Runoff for House District 151 set for Dec 1
items.text: Mike Cheokas (R) leads Ethan Wolfe (D) by 7.0 points, but no candidate won a majority. The top two will face off in a runoff on Dec 1.

items.title: Automatic hand recount for Governor
items.text: A 2026 law requires a hand recount of every ballot in every county for the Governor's race if it is decided by 0.5% or less. The Secretary of State must order the recount within two business days after the Nov 9 county certification deadline.

src.t: SB 3EX as signed (Office of the Governor)

items.title: Dec 1 runoff election
items.text: Runoff for any race in which no candidate won a majority. The House District 151 race is headed to this date.
